ogtr.name: DIR 146 — Banana (Musa spp.) field trial (site SH), Litchfield Municipality
ogtr.desc: WHAT. A licensed GMO crop field trial site, Disease resistance, Selectable marker – antibiotic, held by Queensland University of Technology. WHERE IT SITS. OGTR named the council area this site is in and published no coordinate on the page this was read from, so this marker sits in that council area and not at the trial itself. WHY IT MATTERS. OGTR names the council area of every licensed site, its area in hectares and the licence it runs under. No other register on this map states where a release is at all, which is the comparison worth making even at this resolution.
